notes: Stories created without duplicating prior audit logging concepts; aligned to existing debug_logger foundation.

BL-0.1.4-004-S6.title: Audit Event Schema and Contract Extension
BL-0.1.4-004-S6.description: Define and standardize audit event schema including actor, action, timestamp, tool_call metadata, request/response hashes, and correlation IDs, extending existing debug_logger structure for immutability readiness.

BL-0.1.4-004-S7.title: Append-Only Write Pipeline Implementation
BL-0.1.4-004-S7.description: Implement backend write pipeline enforcing append-only behavior (no updates/deletes), including sequential write guarantees and hash linkage between records for tamper evidence.

BL-0.1.4-004-S8.title: Audit Logging Integration with Tool Router and Services
BL-0.1.4-004-S8.description: Integrate audit logging into tool_router and domain services to capture all system actions and tool calls, including inputs, outputs, and execution metadata without impacting existing flows.

BL-0.1.4-004-S9.title: Audit Log Integrity and Tamper Detection Tests
BL-0.1.4-004-S9.description: Create unit and integration tests validating append-only guarantees, hash chain integrity, and detection of any tampering or mutation attempts in stored audit records.

BL-0.1.4-004.mitigation: Leverage existing debug_logger patterns and enforce append-only at application layer without new infrastructure.
